latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of affiliate-link-injector.

- Automatically scans content for product mentions and inserts tracked affiliate links with FTC-compliant disclosures.
- Supports Amazon Associates, ShareASale, Impact, CJ Affiliate, and custom networks.
- Compatible with platforms including WordPress, Google Docs, Substack, and more.
- Features intelligent product detection, context-aware link injection, and compliance audit reporting.
- Provides multi-language disclosures and configurable compliance modes.
